title: MV (Solved) Use left / right keys, instead of pageup / pagedown in choice list

posts.author: MerchantLegends
posts.body:
Hey folks. I made a large Choice list. It will have potentially 100+ choices. It works great!
If you want to speed up or down the list, you can use pageup and pagedown keys by default in RPG Maker MV.
I'd like to allow the user to press left and right keys, in addition to  pageup / pagedown to jump up and down the list.
Any ideas how I can allow this?

posts.author: caethyril
